messages:
Maya: Quick idea 3: mini Holiday Postcard Chain + optional Virtual Carol Karaoke next Thu? Low-effort, high cheer. :postbox::musical_note:

Ken: Love it. Postcards sound great. Is this physical cards only or e-cards welcome?

Maya: Physical preferred but e-cards definitely welcome for remote folks. We9ll have a labeled bin in the kitchen: "Holiday Postcards". Drop by Wed COB.

Jules: I can print a QR code people can scan to add their name and shipping address if they want to send internationally. Avoids typos.

Ravi: I vote for a theme 3: "Recycled wrapping paper art" or "Awkward holiday sweater selfies" so we can pick winners for silly categories.

Hannah: Omg awkward sweater selfies is a must. Also can we have a tiny prize? Stickers + a mystery tea bag? :laughing:

Maya: Tiny prizes: yes. Winner categories: "Most Nostalgic Message", "Cheesiest Pun", "Ugly Sweater Champion". Stickers + a mini mug for first place.

seasonal-bot: Reminder: Postcard drop-off window closes Wed 5:00 PM. Virtual Carol Karaoke sign-up closes Thu 6:00 PM.

Ken: For the karaoke, half of me wants to do "All I Want For Christmas" and the other half remembers last year's key-change disaster. :grimacing: Can we do both live and pre-recorded submissions?

Jules: Pre-recorded option good idea. Less pressure for people who can9t be on camera or are in weird time zones. We can compile a 30-min highlights reel for the all-hands slack.

Ravi: I9ll run the Zoom + queue. Can people DM me clips or drop them in a folder?

Maya: Drop in #files/postcard-carol-2025 or DM Ravi if you prefer. Please name files like `name-song.mp4`.

Hannah: Can we have a consolation category for "Most Likely to Steal Another Person's Lyrics"? Asking for a friend. :joy:

Ken: Also: would love cards to include one silly local tradition or recipe so we can swap cultural holiday things. Tiny footnote of learning.

Jules: Added category "Best Tiny Tradition". Also created the signup sheet: https://intranet.redwood/postcard-chain-2025 (please add name + postal/virtual preference).

Maya: If you're remote and want to send a postcard from your city, let us know early so we can coordinate addresses. We may consolidate shipments to one person to drop at the office.

Ravi: Logistics note: if shipping plants or food items, please check with ops first. We9re sticking to paper + small wrapped candies only.

Hannah: I will probably send a card that smells faintly of cinnamon. Consider yourself warned. :wink:

Ken: Sign me up for karaoke (pre-record). Also adding my city postcard contribution (Seattle).

Maya: Thanks all! Final reminder: postcard box on kitchen labeled "Holiday Postcards" + QR on the counter for the sheet. Karaoke next Thu 5:30 PM PT (hybrid). Bring your voices and outrageously festive headwear. :party_parrot:

seasonal-bot: Event created: Holiday Postcard Chain & Carol Karaoke 3: Thu 17:30 PT. RSVP here: https://calendar.redwood/events/holiday-carol-2025

Jules: Photo idea 3: compile a collage of received postcards and share in #random for remote smiles.

Maya: Love that. Collage will go up Fri morning. Thanks everyone, fun minimal-commitment holiday vibes.

Ken: Can we have a tweak to the karaoke rulebook: no key modulations after chorus 2 unless pre-arranged. For the love of our vocal cords. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
